name: @andpay/analytics-service
description: The S19 analytics/reporting rail (spec 11), the first BUILT-V1 READ-ONLY platform service. Owns the analytics schema: a raw-then-modeled read model built from fct.* facts (raw_event ingest, dispatch_row modeled layer) served through a mediation layer, plus the shared outbox/inbox infra and a per-topic watermark. Holds no money (S20) and never reads another context's schema (C4).
